brief.question: Does tau=0.5 Load Once reduce measured free-generation TPOT beyond exact static-hot and the matched hot-only routing control?
brief.healthy: Per-visit KV verification and full-resident/offload greedy tokens must match. All expert weights are removed from GPU before physical-cache timing. Three interleaved repetitions per request.
brief.noise: Prefix streaming and cache preloading are excluded from TPOT but TTFT is saved separately. Full-resident references are not interleaved and cannot establish a paired latency advantage.
brief.worth_a_flag: Foreign GPU process, physical budget overflow, executor mismatch, offload changed tokens, nonfinite latency or zero copies on native static.
brief.from_parent: Ouro at 3.99GiB tau=0.5: test NLL penalty 0.01517 and logical copies 56.40 to 33.68. Same-budget hot-only copies 35.37. These are not measured latency gains.
brief.decided: No compensation training in this run. Seek >5 percent repeatable TPOT reduction, then judge incremental value beyond hot-only.
